proposal.hypothesis: Prior search measurements found split ranges with rsqrt at 0.001025174 s and rsqrt with factor-four unrolling at 0.001009364 s. This candidate combines split ranges and factor-four unrolling to test whether unrolling offsets loop-control costs while retaining the rsqrt arithmetic. The change may instead increase instruction or control overhead; these measurements do not establish a cause or a confirmed speedup.

retained: Replace the conditional single source loop with two ranges, [0, i) and (i, n), so j=i is never evaluated.
Apply factor-four unrolling to both ranges and use rsqrtf-based inverse-distance cubed arithmetic, retaining target-mass multiplication and final force-per-target-mass division.
Preserve one target per thread, the existing launch configuration, and no shared-memory tiling or multi-target coarsening.
